description: This file implements the ProcessInfo class and related functions for process management, memory usage, and process hierarchy traversal in a cross-platform manner, including Windows, Linux, and macOS.

classes.name: MemRange
classes.description: Helper struct to parse memory map lines from /proc/PID/maps, representing a memory range with start and end addresses.

methods.name: ExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable name or path of a process given its handle or PID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: FindChildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process ID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds process IDs matching a given name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: ProcessNameByCmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command name of a process given its PID.

methods.name: GetParentPid
methods.description: Retrieves the parent process ID of a given process.

methods.name: FindChildrenWithName
methods.description: Finds child processes of a specific parent process ID and maps their names to PIDs.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::ProcessInfo
methods.description: Constructs a ProcessInfo object for the current process or a specific process ID.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Returns the amount of memory allocated by the process.

methods.name: Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident set size (RSS) memory of the process.

methods.name: Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size of the process.

methods.name: Jiffies
methods.description: Returns the total CPU time used by the process in jiffies.

methods.name: Executable
methods.description: Returns the full path of the process executable.

methods.name: CommandLine
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments of the process.

methods.name: MarkOccupiedPages
methods.description: Marks occupied pages in memory for the process based on /proc/PID/pagemap.
